rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance annual allowable rent increase (3/1/2026–2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable rent increase effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the 3/1/2026–2/28/2027 allowable-increase period stated on the Rent Board page.

unverifiable_exemptions: rent-controlled unit status (e.g., single-family/condo, owner-occupied, subsidized exemptions) not verifiable from parcel data

rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rent-controlled units under the SF Rent Ordinance.

parsed.doc_summary: SF Rent Board announcement that the annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units is 1.6% for 3/1/2026–2/28/2027 (prior year 1.4%).
